python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('w', W)
ET.register_namespace('ve', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006')
ET.register_namespace('o', 'urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office')
ET.register_namespace('r', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships')
ET.register_namespace('v', 'urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml')
ET.register_namespace('wp', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing')
ET.register_namespace('w10', 'urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:word')

DOC = 'unpacked_qr/word/document.xml'
tree = ET.parse(DOC)
body = tree.getroot().find(f'{{{W}}}body')

def paragraph_text(p):
    return ''.join(t.text or '' for t in p.iter(f'{{{W}}}t'))

def is_headline(text):
    stripped = text.strip()
    has_letter = any(c.isalpha() for c in stripped)
    return has_letter and stripped == stripped.upper()

count = 0
for p in body.iter(f'{{{W}}}p'):
    if not is_headline(paragraph_text(p)):
        continue
    for r in p.findall(f'{{{W}}}r'):
        rpr = r.find(f'{{{W}}}rPr')
        if rpr is None:
            rpr = ET.Element(f'{{{W}}}rPr')
            r.insert(0, rpr)
        for u in rpr.findall(f'{{{W}}}u'):
            rpr.remove(u)
        u = ET.Element(f'{{{W}}}u')
        u.set(f'{{{W}}}val', 'single')
        szcs = rpr.find(f'{{{W}}}sz-cs')
        if szcs is not None:
            rpr.insert(list(rpr).index(szcs) + 1, u)
        else:
            rpr.append(u)
    count += 1

tree.write(DOC, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8')
print(f'Underlined {count} headline paragraph(s)')
PYEOF
